blurb: Chattooga Belle Farm Distillery is the first legal distillery in Oconee County, South Carolina. They produce award-winning spirits and offer tours and tastings. The distillery is open Wednesday through Saturday from 10 am to 6 pm, closed Sunday through Tuesday except for scheduled tours by appointment.
extraNote: Distillery closed Monday and Tuesday except for scheduled tours by appointment · Farm to Table tickets must be purchased by Oct 4, 2026
